definition: אֲפֻדָּה noun feminine ephod (= אֵפוֺד , for which it supplies construct & suffix forms). 1. of high-priest's ephod, compare אֵפוֺד 1 b , only חֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֺ Exod 28:8 ; Exod 39:5 the cunningly-wrought band of his ephod. 2. of sheathing of idol-images, אֲפֻדַּת מַסֵּכַתוְהָכֶ֑ךָ Isa 30:22 (|| צִפוּי פְסִילֵי כַסְפֶּ ךָ ) compare אֵפוֺר 3 a.

אֲפֻדָּה noun feminine ephod (= אֵפוֺד, for which it supplies construct & suffix forms).

1. of high-priest's ephod, compare אֵפוֺד 1 b, only חֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֺExod 28:8; Exod 39:5 the cunningly-wrought band of his ephod.
2. of sheathing of idol-images, אֲפֻדַּת מַסֵּכַתוְהָכֶ֑ךָIsa 30:22 (|| צִפוּי פְסִילֵי כַסְפֶּ ךָ) compare אֵפוֺר 3 a.
